newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk police arrest 17 members of Islamic group.
newsitem.headline: Turk police arrest 17 members of Islamic group.

text.p: Turkish police have arrested 17 people in the southern coastal city of Antalya for membership of an illegal Islamic group and trying to overthrow the constitutional order, Anatolian news agency said on Monday.

The 17 were charged with membership of the outlawed Anatolian Federal Islamic State and trying to replace the the constitution with a system based on religious principles, the state-run agency said, without giving further details.

Turkey's military and secularist establishment are locked in a war of attrition with the Islamist-led government of Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan over the army's demands that the government curb what it sees as growing Islamist zeal.

A six-hour extraordinary meeting of the Supreme Military Council on Monday announced the army had decided to deal with suspected Islamic activists in its own ranks, putting pressure on Erbakan to implement the demand.
